notes.title: New Boss Added: Dark Knight
notes.notes:
[h2]New Boss Added: Dark Knight![/h2]

[h3]This melee oriented boss will appear on any level around the 10:00 minute mark. I'm also planning on making him even [i]more[/i] difficult in the future. [/h3]

notes.title: Patch Notes 01.21.2023.01
notes.notes: Fixed frost damage being incorrectly applied to none frost weapons.

notes.title: Patch Notes 01.16.2023.01
notes.notes:
-Possible fix to AI navigation issues.
-Fixed animations for the Fire Staff and the Frost Staff.

notes.title: First Range Enemy + Other Fixes/Reworks
notes.notes:
[h3]Added new enemy type: [b]Sorcerer![/b]
Sorcerer is the first enemy type with a long range attack[/h3]

[list]
[*] Increased max rank.
[*] Buffed later stage orcs to increase challenge.
[*] Reworked melee unlocks.
[*] Fixed melee unlock glitch.
[*] Further nerfed AOE abilities.
[*] (More upgrades will now be needed to reach the same level as before.)
[*] Improved spawn times (more needs to be done however...)
[*] Nerfed armor upgrades.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 01.12.2023.01
notes.notes:
-Nerfed AOE based abilities
        -AOEs now do less damage
        -Enemy speed penalty reduced when freezing
        -More upgrades required
        -Max AOE range lowered

-Fixed key drop rate
-Fixed double XP glitch
-Fixed enemy timers not resetting 
-Improved enemy distribution on Double (more work needs to be done)

notes.title: Orc Survivors Has Been Released!
notes.notes:
Hope you enjoy!

Expect a couple patches over the next few days to address any bugs/balance issues.

Thank you!

notes.title: Release Date Revealed!
notes.notes:
[h3]Orc Survivors will be launching January 11th, 2023 at approx 7:00 AM PST.[/h3]
[h3]Hope you're looking forward to it![/h3]






[i]Note: Achievements may not available on launch but, should be available at a later date.[/i]
